notes.title: Road to Steam Next Fest – New Mission Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
We’re excited to announce that Beyond Enemy Lines – Vietnam will be part of Steam Next Fest!

To mark the occasion, we’ll be updating the demo with brand-new singleplayer content when the festival begins.

[b]Incoming: Operation Game Warden[/b]
Launching with the Steam Next Fest update, we’re adding a new standalone mission: Operation Game Warden.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43213540/2ce65aaf97fb4d3dae70d1a81fa0e24fe209423e.jpg[/img]

This mission is inspired by the real-world U.S. Navy operation in the Mekong Delta, aimed at disrupting Viet Cong supply lines along the rivers and canals of South Vietnam.

In-game, Operation Missions are not part of the main campaign. They are independent missions based on real historical operations, designed as large open-ended battlefields. Objectives are scattered across a wide area, and players are given complete tactical freedom to choose how and in what order they engage them - a structure reminiscent of previous Beyond Enemy Lines titles.

Unlike the Gridlock mission currently featured in the demo, which is more scripted and focused, Operation Game Warden offers a looser structure with minimal scripting and an emphasis on replayability. Both approaches offer freedom - Gridlock through layered combat encounters, and Game Warden through full non-linear sandbox design.

We’re adding this mission specifically to hear your thoughts on this alternative mission flow.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43213540/37f1e08c75d7a2f3f64d30d5426f3b6e1210abc8.jpg[/img]

📅 [b]Demo Update Timeline[/b]
The Steam Next Fest update goes live with the start of the event.
Until then, you can already jump into the current demo, featuring the campaign mission Gridlock.

💬 [b]Help Us Improve the Game[/b]
We are actively monitoring feedback and fixing bugs while the demo is live. Your reports help us address critical issues and shape the final game - in real time.

🛠 [b]Found a bug?[/b]
💡 Got ideas or preferences?
📣 Share them through the in-game feedback prompt or on the Steam forums.

notes.title: Beyond Enemy Lines – Vietnam: Technical Playtest Begins Now!
notes.notes:
We're kicking off our technical playtest today, May 23 – a bit differently than planned.

[previewyoutube=OeL0vvx32zQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Due to a pending approval for the dedicated Playtest App, we've decided to launch the Steam Demo version early instead. This version will be updated continuously based on your feedback and will remain available for about one month, including during Steam Next Fest.

[b]What's in the demo?[/b]
You'll experience a slice of a campaign mission with multiple replayable routes. Each run takes between 30 and 60 minutes. Weapons can be ranked up, and attachments unlocked.

[b]What we're looking for:[/b]
[list]
[*] How well does it run on your system?
[*] Did you encounter any critical bugs or crashes?
[*] Are there design elements you’d like to see improved?
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43213540/4b37ec36792022fa2d73018e6eaae9840337a769.jpg[/img]

⚠️ [b]This is a work-in-progress. Expect bugs, placeholder content, and unfinished systems. Your input will directly shape how the game evolves.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43213540/09c9c962a47625315bd933e566b6c10ee0809d63.jpg[/img]

🐛 [b]Known & Expected Bugs[/b]
As this is an early work-in-progress build, some issues are known and currently being addressed:

[list]
[*] [b]Unresponsive AI Behavior[/b]
Enemy AI may occasionally fail to react properly. This is often caused by missing information nodes or the inability to find valid cover. We're actively adjusting these systems to strike the right balance between performance and intelligent behavior.

[*] [b]Weapon Rank Display Bug[/b]
In some cases, the in-game weapon rank may appear to reset or decrease after restarting a mission. This is purely a visual issue — your actual progress and weapon stats remain unaffected.

[*] [b]Audio Mixing Incomplete[/b]
The overall sound mix is still under development. Expect placeholder audio, inconsistent volume levels, and general imbalance. This is a key area we’ll be improving over the coming weeks.

[*] [b]Gameplay Lag Spikes[/b]
You may experience minor stutters or lag spikes, particularly when loading new sections of the level. We’re aware of this and working on smoother level streaming and performance optimizations.
[/list]

Please continue to share your experiences — your feedback is critical as we refine the game.

notes.title: Beyond Enemy Lines - Vietnam Dev-Log #04: Mission Editor
notes.notes:
Hello, Beyond Enemy Lines - Vietnam community!

We’re excited to share a first look at our in-game Mission Editor! Here’s what’s coming to empower your creativity and expand the game’s potential with custom missions, cross-platform play, and even creator DLC opportunities.

[previewyoutube=OXZqJZ-daWs;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Key Features of the Mission Editor[/h2]
🔹 [b]Cross-Platform Creation[/b]:
Easily create and play missions on PC, Xbox, and PlayStation with support for gamepad or keyboard and mouse.

🔹 [b]Pre-Built Assets & Customization Options[/b]:
Jumpstart your mission with a library of pre-built assets and creation kits. Note: all assets are still in development and will evolve before release.

🔹 [b]Time & Weather Control[/b]:
Adjust time of day and weather conditions in real-time—or change them dynamically during missions using custom scripts.

🔹 [b]User-Friendly Scripting[/b]:
Place script actors within your mission, customize their properties, and set conditions seamlessly with an easy-to-navigate properties panel.

🔹 [b]Real-Time Testing & Saving[/b]:
Save, load, and upload your creations with ease, and test them instantly within the editor.

🔹 [b]Large, Open Missions or Intricate Interiors[/b]:
Design sprawling outdoor missions with predefined landscapes or create detailed indoor scenarios—or combine both!

🔹 [b]Build Full Campaigns[/b]:
Develop full campaigns with seamless level transitions to tell your own story within Beyond Enemy Lines - Vietnam.

🔹 [b]Co-op & PvP Ready[/b]:
Create missions for solo play, co-op, and even PvP battles with our flexible mission editor.

💡 [h2]Creator Program[/h2]
Submit Your Campaigns:
Want to go further? Submit your custom campaigns (with at least 3 missions) for our review. If selected, we’ll polish your missions using our in-house tools and release them as official Creator DLC. [b]You’ll receive 50% of the earnings![/b]

We’d love your feedback on this early version of the Mission Editor to make it the best it can be. Thank you for your support, and please feel free to leave a comment with your ideas and suggestions.

Stay tuned for more updates and, as always, happy mission-building!

Sincerely,
Polygon Art

We regret to inform you that the release of Beyond Enemy Lines - Vietnam has been delayed. The decision to postpone the launch comes as we strive to enhance the gaming experience for our players by introducing a fully playable co-op campaign alongside the single-player mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43213540/95c1e6ab59c559995253d4c324a56940cd7f24fa.jpg[/img]

This significant addition to the game's features required extensive restructuring and rework, expanding the initial scope of the project. We believe that integrating a cooperative gameplay element will enrich the overall experience, allowing players to embark on thrilling missions together in the treacherous jungles of Vietnam.

While this delay may be disappointing, we assure you that progress on the game is steadily advancing. We are committed to delivering a polished and immersive experience that exceeds expectations. As development continues, we will keep you updated through future development logs, where we will showcase more content and provide insights into the game's development process.

In the meantime, we invite you to enjoy two stunning in-game landscape screenshots, offering a glimpse into the immersive world of Beyond Enemy Lines.

notes.title: Evolution of Weapon Animations in Beyond Enemy Lines Franchise (2017-2023)
notes.notes:

From the early days of using animations from Asset Packs in Beyond Enemy Lines 1 and 2, the franchise has come a long way in terms of visual fidelity. The first significant leap in animation quality was witnessed in Beyond Enemy Lines Remastered Edition, where the development team introduced their own custom animations, marking a notable improvement over the previous titles.

However, the upcoming Beyond Enemy Lines - Vietnam takes the weapon animations to a whole new level. Building upon the foundations laid in the Remastered Edition, the developers have crafted vastly enhanced and immersive weapon animations that further enhance the gameplay experience. With meticulous attention to detail and fluidity, these new animations bring the weapons to life, immersing players in the intense atmosphere of the Vietnam War setting.
